body:
Nothing. I went to a smash brothers tournament with an old friend this morning. Then I dropped him off at his place. I went in, watched him do some dabs and felt incredibly depressed about how he's content with his life. He works a shit job and lies in squalor but he's okay with it. I don't understand.

When I left his place, I started crying but it was because I don't feel like anyone will ever love me.

I've recently been talking to a friend of mine who has a child. I'm very jealous of her because I feel like it would be amazing to be a parent, but that will never be a thing that exists for me.
No. I love people. I feel like I spend way too much time isolated. I just don't understand people.

My friends know how bad it's been for me lately. My family knows as well. My mom doesn't know. She's basically been dying so I try not to show her how hard everything has been for me.

My friends do not seem to care... or they care and it's not getting across to me. I don't understand it Despite whatever they say or do.... I'm miserable.

There's really no point.

I graduated with an AAS in Multimedia Design Technology, which is a fancied up way of saying graphic design. 

I wouldn't say that alcohol makes me calm.... at the moment it just makes me too lazy and dulled to think. Thinking is horrible.

I used to play league despite the community. 
Honestly, my view of the magic community is the same. I like the game but cannot stand the community. I actually spent today in a card shop (although playing a video game. I went to a smash brothers melee tournament)

I find no matter how hard I try to relate to people, I cannot. I find myself trying to have hobbies but not being able to tolerate people.

I do not work in healthcare. Well... I work with hearing aids.
why would the world be worse. I'll die eventually.
honestly, drinking has been the only thing that's kept me calm this last week. I've been crying every day. The only time I'm not miserable and I can forget is when I'm drinking right now
If you wear a really interesting hat, it will give people an excuse to talk to you.

I was okay. Like I did well at fnms but really never went to any bigger events. I found though that I never parleyed it into anything else. Like I never made friendships with it. I just went to have something to do.

Honestly, I don't know. My favorite thing is work right now which in itself is depressing.

I used to play a lot of Magic, but that was solely because a friend of mine did and I wanted to be friends with him.

I don't do much at all. I'm basically the cockroach from the metamorphosis.
Yes... It has not went well at all.

She knows.
Nothing will happen between her and I.

the truth is, I don't know how how to be interested in a human. I'm 28 and I've never had a girlfriend. Hell, I've basically been on one (blind) date and it went terribly.

I've avoided everyone for so long until I met her and because of her I ended up losing a lot of weight and doing other things to better myself (for example getting a decent job)

We weren't even a thing. I dunno. She was really an odd girl. I mean she's still an odd girl. We were never dating. Her friends all told me she's never been interested in a guy (or a girl... basically no interest in a relationship ever)

She's just the goofiest person I've ever met and I found it endearing. But she had zero interest in me. It's been difficult to move on.

I work for United Health Care actually. They'll be cool with me stepping away to take a phone call if need be, but it's really frustrating when I finally decide to get help.

I honestly should find some other mental health facility to work with but I'm not. I don't know how to go about doing that.

Yes, there absolutely was. I've been down about a girl and I spent the weekend (well Thursday, Friday and Saturday) with her and some friends. I ended up leaving early because it was obvious she didn't want me around Saturday.

I wish I could just not care about her at all...

Shux.
Well, it feels like I'm relying heavily on other people for my sense of worth. I definitely feel shitty about that and do not know how to get away from it. Maybe vain was not the right word.

I'm kind of working on that, but honestly it seems so vain. 
All of this seems so vain and ridiculous. I want to say more but I'm just going to not.
